description: Update your own UI preferences: default time-entry view, sub-views, theme, and time format. Only the fields you provide are changed (PATCH semantics). Applies to your account globally across all organizations. The user is fixed by your context — you can only change your own preferences.

default_day_sub_view.description: Default sub-view for the day view. One of: timeline, list, stats, table.

default_month_sub_view.description: Default sub-view for the month view. One of: calendar, list, timeline.

default_time_entry_view.description: Default time-entry view. One of: day, week, month.

default_week_sub_view.description: Default sub-view for the week view. One of: calendar, list, timeline.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

theme_preference.description: UI theme preference. One of: light, dark, system.

name: update_user_preferences
